Dear colleagues,

We are writing to share some general housekeeping notes from Bluefinch Fabrication. Routine questions can now go to our new shared inbox; there is no need to copy personal addresses any more. Please be aware that the billing desk is shut on Friday afternoon while software is upgraded. Our delivery crew had no trouble with the site gate this week.

These notes are shared for information only and do not call for any action on your side. Should anything be unclear, our usual contacts remain available during office hours.

Kind regards,

Rafi
Bluefinch Fabrication
--
